source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Thanks for this. I'll get some views and feedback. One thing I wanted your input on was the color/shape/size of buttons in the shell (I'm calling it Console going forward). I haven't styled them yet and they currently default to largish buttons with rounded corners in a shade of blue. Do you think we should use a color or switch to monochrome? I'm thinking maybe we should also include an icon on every button just for interest.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Here's a couple of screens in light and dark theme. Let me know if you need more. I'm looking at other people's consoles like chatbots, upwork, RingCentral, etc. Many of them use mono buttons.
I like the purple footer by the way.

ambiguity.description: The button treatment remains unresolved between the freelancer's proposed branded-color treatment and the client's consideration of monochrome buttons; final shape, size, and icon usage are also undecided.

routing_warnings.description: The submitted design is described only as a Console UI and does not specifically entail implementation of the button treatment.
The client reports finalizing the Console's general look-and-feel and layout without identifying the button treatment.
